etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text:
This word was derived from ancient Japanese origin かたし (katashi, “hard”) and applied the meaning of Chinese letter 堅／坚 that means keeping its physical shape or behavior by its excellent quality.
In turn, from Old Japanese kata, from Proto-Japonic *kata.

etymologies.heading: Etymology
etymologies.text: Originally, there was no means to write the geminate consonant, so it was left out. Pronunciation was likely [nikki] rather than [niki].
